name: gizza-ai/regex-column-validate
summary: Validate CSV column values with a regex

tool.description: Validate one CSV column against a regular expression. Flags non-matching values by default, or matching values for forbidden-pattern checks. Supports header or index column selection, delimiter auto-detection, full-cell versus match-anywhere mode, case-insensitive matching, blank-cell policy, capped issue lists, and text or JSON reports.

allow_blank.description: Treat blank cells as valid without testing the regex.

column.description: Target column header name, or a 0-based column index. Numeric values are always treated as indexes.

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter. Auto detects comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe from the first non-blank line.

full_match.description: Require the pattern to match the whole cell. Turn off to accept a match anywhere inside the cell.

has_header.description: Treat the first CSV row as headers. Turn off to use 0-based numeric column indexes.

max_issues.description: Maximum number of offending rows to list; total invalid count is still reported.

output.description: Output format: readable text report or structured JSON.

pattern.description: Rust regular expression to test against each cell. Use inline flags like (?i), (?m), or (?s) for advanced modes.

report.description: Which rows to flag: values that do not match, or values that do match (for forbidden-pattern checks).
